title: Law to study racial and income gaps in building violation enforcement
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings to study and report on racial, geographic and socioeconomic disparities in how building violations, penalties, inspections and foreclosures are enforced across the city. The report, due within one year of the law taking effect, must use at least 10 years of data broken down by property type, borough, community district and race, and include policy recommendations. The Department of Finance and the Department of Housing Preservation and Development would be required to supply relevant data for the study.
